hypotheses.R1_rank2_semantics: On held-out corpora, whitened top-2 modes have median oriented AUROC at least 0.75 and lose no more than 0.08 relative to the full form.
hypotheses.R2_rank2_causality: On disjoint full-feature-selected sites, whitened top-2 spike fidelity has median at least 0.30 and beats its complementary bulk for at least four of five categories.
hypotheses.R3_significant_only: Using only modes above each feature's preregistered null threshold gives median semantic causal fidelity at least 0.20 and exceeds matched controls by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.R4_rank4_plateau: Whitened top-4 semantic causal fidelity has median at least 0.50 and is no more than 0.10 below top-16.
hypotheses.R5_raw_robustness: Raw trace-centered top-4 modes have median semantic causal fidelity above 0.30 and exceed matched controls by at least 0.10.
hypotheses.R6_category_specific_stability: The exact five-category cross-seed eigenspace matching permutation test has p at most 0.05 and at least four of five diagonal matches rank first.
